name: Memos
description: An open-source self-hosted notebook built around quick thoughts and a personal timeline.
differentiator: Treats quick notes as a personal timeline rather than a heavyweight document workspace.
limitations: The project describes its own positioning; this is not independent user research.
No validated market-size, payment or retention evidence here.
This is a cataloged existing product, not a verified new launch.

en.who: Imagine remembering an interesting thought but not wanting to organize a full document.
en.pain: A complex notes workspace can create friction for a tiny idea.
en.solution: Memos makes short entries part of a personal chronological stream.
en.benefit: Capturing fleeting thoughts may feel lightweight.
en.uncertainty: Will a timeline remain usable when notes accumulate?

zh.who: 想象你突然想到一句值得记下来的话，却不想为了它建一个文档、选目录、整理标签。
zh.pain: 有时记录一个小想法，工具本身反而太复杂。
zh.solution: Memos 把简短笔记放在自己的时间线上，像记录日常动态一样写下来。
zh.benefit: 捕捉稍纵即逝的想法可能更轻松。
zh.uncertainty: 时间线变长后，检索和整理是否依然方便？

fr.who: Imaginez une idée à noter sans vouloir créer un document entier.
fr.pain: Organiser un espace de notes peut être disproportionné pour une phrase.
fr.solution: Memos place les petites notes dans une chronologie personnelle.
fr.benefit: Noter les idées spontanées pourrait être plus facile.
fr.uncertainty: La chronologie reste-t-elle pratique après des centaines de notes ?
